description: Exploring the universe through the lens of physics, from mechanics and electromagnetism to quantum phenomena and astrophysics. Fascinated by the principles that govern our world, connecting scientific ideas, and exploring questions that lead to even bigger questions. My goal is to make the most of this unique experience, explore physics beyond textbooks, challenge myself, and create unforgettable memories along the way.
summary: EARTH PULSE transforms NASA Earth data into sound, combining data visualization and sonification to help people explore and understand environmental changes in a more interactive and accessible way. By translating scientific data into sound, the project offers a new way to experience and connect with our changing planet.
details: EARTH PULSE is an interactive project that transforms NASA Earth data into sound through data sonification. Using temperature data from the Equatorial Pacific Ocean, the project maps temperature values to sound frequency and annual temperature changes to amplitude. It combines scientific data, visualizations, and sound to provide a more engaging and accessible way to explore environmental changes.
